items.question: Do you provide free estimates?
items.answer: Yes. We provide clear, itemized written estimates.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured in NYC?
items.answer: Yes. Hammer Brick & Home LLC is licensed, bonded and insured. NYC HIC #2131291.

items.question: Do you handle permits?
items.answer: When permits are required, we explain the process and can coordinate with the appropriate licensed professionals.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: We serve Staten Island, Brooklyn, Queens, Manhattan, the Bronx and select New Jersey areas.
